section_summary.extract_value: This section details a meta-analysis combining the results from Study 1 and Study 2 to examine the relationship between creative achievement scores and LI scores. The combined analysis, which weighted both studies equally due to similar IQ and creative achievement samples, revealed a highly significant effect size of r = 0.31 when comparing LI scores between high-CAQ and low-CAQ groups.
